== Biography ==
John was born about 1817 ''(estimated from [https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/find-a-grave-prod/photos/2013/332/29774986_138577979446.jpg Aged 61  years])''.  John S. Glasgow was the son of John Glasgow and Elizabeth Jane ''Bell'' Glasgow.  

He married (first)  Sarah J Leamer Glasgow (1820 - 1865); 

John married (second) Mary E. ''(LNAB Unknown)'' Glasgow.  He passed away 12 Jan 1881Æ 64, and was buried at Mount Zion Lutheran Cemetery, Glasgow, Cambria County, Pennsylvania.
